info.name: 1702 Series Quad Block Motor Mount (32-2)
info.function: Motor mount that fastens a Neverest Orbital 20 or REV HD Hex Planetary Gear Motor to the goBILDA system. It has threaded holes on the sides and the face, and the motor can be installed from either side.
